gloss: to be full of anticipation; to be filled with expectation

definitions.gloss: to be full of anticipation; to be filled with expectation
definitions.explanation: To be brimming with eager anticipation or hopeful expectation about something that is going to happen.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{目|め}で{見|み}つめていた。
examples.english: She was gazing with eyes full of expectation.

examples.japanese: {新入生|しんにゅうせい}たちは{期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{表情|ひょうじょう}で{入学式|にゅうがくしき}に{臨|のぞ}んだ。
examples.english: The new students attended the entrance ceremony with expressions full of anticipation.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{雰囲気|ふんいき}の{中|なか}、{新製品|しんせいひん}の{発表|はっぴょう}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Amid an atmosphere brimming with anticipation, the announcement of the new product began.

notes:
Combines {期待|きたい} (expectation; anticipation) with に{満|み}ちる (to be filled with). Most commonly used in the past participle form {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた as a modifier before nouns like {目|め} (eyes), {表情|ひょうじょう} (expression), or {雰囲気|ふんいき} (atmosphere).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{表情|ひょうじょう}: an expression full of anticipation
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{目|め}: eyes full of expectation
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{声|こえ}: a voice brimming with expectation
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた{雰囲気|ふんいき}: an atmosphere full of anticipation

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {希望|きぼう}に{満|み}ちる: to be full of hope — focuses on hope rather than expectation
- {期待|きたい}に{胸|むね}を{膨|ふく}らませる: to swell with anticipation — more vivid, emphasizes the physical sensation of excitement
- わくわくする: to be excited; thrilled — more casual and emotive
